title: Create a URL Slug
description: Convert text to a lowercase URL slug. Treat any run of characters other than ASCII letters and digits as one hyphen, then remove hyphens from the start and end.

solution.explanation: Lowercase the text, replace every run of non-ASCII letters and digits with one hyphen, and trim edge hyphens. A regex handles punctuation, whitespace, and repeated separators consistently. This makes repeated punctuation behave consistently.

tests.hint: Whitespace separates words with a hyphen.
Collapse repeated whitespace into one separator.
Runs of punctuation produce one hyphen.
Remove punctuation while keeping word boundaries.
Periods are separators in this slug rule.
Underscores and periods use the same separator.
The rule intentionally retains ASCII letters only.
A long input should remain linear in its length.
